# `@filemark/kanban` — component plan Second rich component after the datagrid + chart. Purely visual — groups a CSV by a column and renders each group as a column of cards. **Read-only**: no drag-drop, no shadow state. User edits the CSV in their editor; auto-refresh re-renders. That keeps filemark aligned with its reader-first identity. - **Status:** plan (nothing built — building now) - **Companion doc:** `docsi/KANBAN.md` (written alongside the code) - **Opened:** 2026-04-23 --- ## 1. Goals Author groups tabular data into a board without learning a new syntax: ````md ```kanban group-by=status card-title=title card-fields=owner,priority id,title,status,owner,priority r-1,Ship grid v2,wip,Ada,P0 r-2,Typed filters,done,Grace,P1 ``` ```` Or the tag form for external CSV: ```md ``` --- ## 2. Dependencies **Zero new** — reuses what already exists: - `@filemark/datagrid` → `parseCSV`, `CellRenderer`, column type inference. Cards render secondary fields through the datagrid's rich CellRenderer, so every type (status pill, avatar, tags, currency, checkbox, progress bar, sparkline, etc.) works inside a card with no extra wiring. - `@filemark/core` → `StorageAdapter`, `AssetResolver` (for `src=`). - No recharts, no dnd-kit, no lucide — just React + Tailwind. --- ## 3. Authoring surface Three paths mirror the datagrid / chart pattern: ### 3.1 Fenced `kanban` block (inline data) ````md ```kanban group-by=status order=todo,wip,done card-title=title id,title,status,owner 1,Ship datagrid,done,Ada 2,Wire charts,wip,Grace 3,Write kanban,wip,Linus 4,Ship forms,todo,Margaret ``` ```` ### 3.2 `` tag (external data) ```md ``` ### 3.3 `src=#id` reference to a prior fence (optional v2) Not v1 — noted here so the grammar accounts for it. --- ## 4. Data pipeline ``` fence body ─┐ src=./csv ─┼─▶ parseCSV (from @filemark/datagrid) src=https: ─┘ → { columns: Column[], rows: Row[] } │ ▼ groupRows(rows, groupBy, order?) │ ▼ [{ group: "todo", cards: [Row, Row] }, …] │ ▼ → * N → * N ``` Card rendering uses `@filemark/datagrid`'s `CellRenderer` per field, so rich types (status, avatar, tags, …) just work. --- ## 5. Info-string / attribute grammar | Flag | Default | Notes | |---|---|---| | `group-by=` | first column | Required-ish — cards are grouped by its distinct values. | | `order=` | first-appearance | Explicit column order. Values not present in data are skipped. | | `card-title=` | first non-groupBy non-id column | Primary line of each card. | | `card-fields=` | everything except groupBy + title + id | Secondary fields; CellRenderer handles each per its type. | | `card-badge=` | — | Corner badge on each card (e.g. priority status pill). | | `id-column=` / `type:=id` | — | Row id for stable React keys. | | `type:=` | inferred | Force a column type (status, avatar, tags, …). Same grammar as datagrid. | | `hide=` | — | Exclude columns from card rendering. | | `sort=[:asc\|desc]` | — | Within-column card order. | | `count` / `no-count` | on | Column header shows the number of cards. | | `empty` / `no-empty` | on | Show groups with zero cards. | | `title=` | — | Board title above the columns. | | `height=` | 420 | Height of the scrollable board area. | | `src=` | — | Same rules as datagrid — relative via AssetResolver, absolute URL direct fetch. | | `delimiter` / `header` | same as datagrid | CSV parse overrides. | --- ## 6. Plug-in contracts **Card renderer registry** — default card renderer displays: ``` ┌──────────────────────────┐ │ {card-title} │ ← primary, larger font │ ─ {card-fields via CellRenderer} ─ │ 👤 Ada 🏷 rust,go P0 │ └──────────────────────────┘ ``` Consumers can register alternate card layouts: ```ts registerCardRenderer("compact", (ctx) => (
…dense layout…
)); ``` Then author opts in via `card-layout=compact`. Mirrors the chart's plug-in model so custom card designs slot in without touching core. Default shipping layouts: - `default` — vertical stack, primary title on top, fields below - `compact` — one-line card, useful for many-short-cards boards --- ## 7. File layout ``` packages/kanban/ ├── ARCHITECTURE.md internal design (brief, mirrors chart's) ├── package.json ├── tsconfig.json ├── tsup.config.ts └── src/ ├── index.ts public barrel ├── types.ts KanbanOptions, CardRenderContext, … ├── core/ │ ├── parseInfoString.ts info-string → KanbanOptions │ ├── attrsToOptions.ts HTML attrs → KanbanOptions │ ├── groupRows.ts (rows, groupBy, order) → groups │ └── registry.ts card-renderer registry ├── components/ │ ├── Kanban.tsx top-level renderer │ ├── KanbanFromText.tsx parseCSV → Kanban │ ├── KanbanBlock.tsx src= fetch + loading/error → KanbanFromText │ ├── Board.tsx horizontal scrollable columns container │ ├── Column.tsx one column (header + cards) │ └── Card.tsx default card layout └── renderers/ └── compact.tsx optional dense card layout ``` --- ## 8. v1 scope (this session) - Package scaffold (package.json, tsconfig, tsup). - Types: `KanbanOptions`, `CardRenderContext`, `CardRenderer`. - `parseInfoString` + `attrsToOptions` extending the datagrid's tokenizer (same grammar; just kanban-specific keys). - `groupRows` — group by column, respect `order=` + `sort=`. - Default `` layout using `@filemark/datagrid`'s `CellRenderer`. - `` + `` layout (horizontal overflow, sticky column headers). - Fence + `` tag via `KanbanBlock`. - `src=` support (reuses chart's absolute/relative split). - Fullscreen toggle (lift the chart's pattern). - Card layout registry with `default` built in; `compact` as a second built-in for dense views. - Validate: warn on missing `group-by`, missing `card-title` col, etc. - Error card for fatal misconfig. **Explicit non-scope (v2):** - Drag-drop cards between columns (filemark is a reader). - `src=#id` fence reference. - `md` task-list ingest as a data source. - Swimlane grouping (2-D grid of columns × lanes). - WIP limits per column. - Export (JSON/MD/SVG) — would be useful but add later. --- ## 9. Work-item breakdown Exactly the same order + style as chart's, compressed since scope is smaller. 1. `ARCHITECTURE.md` written. 2. `package.json`, `tsconfig.json`, `tsup.config.ts`. 3. `types.ts` — every interface. 4. `core/parseInfoString.ts`, `core/attrsToOptions.ts`, `core/groupRows.ts`, `core/registry.ts`. 5. `components/Card.tsx`, `components/Column.tsx`, `components/Board.tsx`. 6. `components/Kanban.tsx` (top-level), `KanbanFromText.tsx`, `KanbanBlock.tsx` (mirror the datagrid's three-component pattern). 7. Optional `renderers/compact.tsx`. 8. `index.ts` — public barrel. 9. MDX integration — add `"kanban"` lang to MDXViewer + `components.kanban` tag handler. 10. `examples/kanban-full.md` — showcase. 11. Playground: add Kanban section to the gallery. 12. `docsi/KANBAN.md` — technical reference. 13. Full monorepo typecheck + build. 14. **Stop. Await user's "commit".** Estimated effort: **~½ to 1 day of focused work.** --- ## 10. Open questions 1. **Card layout default** — full-card with fields (my plan) vs minimal single-line (closer to Linear)? I default to fuller since rich types make full cards compelling. Can provide `compact` as opt-in. 2. **Empty state** — when a column (e.g. "review") has zero cards, render the empty column frame or skip? Default: show empty (makes the board layout predictable); `no-empty` hides empties. Flag answers both preferences. 3. **Sort default within columns** — preserving file order is reasonable; authors override with `sort=priority:asc`. 4. **Row-id requirement** — optional in v1 (React uses index keys otherwise). When there IS an id column, we use it — helps stability on auto-refresh re-renders. Not fatal if missing.
